kernel.governing_law: Annihilation is not chaotic but scheduled with absolute temporal and numerical precision — restraint was the original state, and its removal is an administrative act emanating from the sacred threshold, releasing forces whose magnitude is heard but not comprehended.
kernel.mutated_relation: The precision is the annihilation — the counting itself is the killing; the schedule does not precede the destruction but constitutes it; the voice from the threshold does not command release but performs the arithmetic of extinction.

independent.recovered_law: The action commanded and performed upon the four angels changes from releasing/loosing (Λῦσον / ἐλύθησαν) in Text A to counting/numbering (Ἀρίθμησον / ἠριθμήθησαν) in Text B, transforming the relation from one of liberation to one of enumeration.
independent.law_match_note: Both claims describe the same structural change: the action upon the angels shifts from releasing/loosing to counting/numbering, transforming liberation into arithmetic of extinction/enumeration.
independent.terminal_note: The final verse (9:16) retains the counting/numbering theme consistently with Text B's changed relation; no reversion to the releasing relation occurs.
